description: Implement GitHub #532 as a provider-neutral Action usable by agents and workflows. Extend the existing Ingestion permission synchronization path with atomic incremental direct-grant add/update/revoke semantics while preserving the BO replacement flow, actor authorization, folder inheritance, and indexed-document synchronization. JidoConnect provider support is explicitly deferred to a GitHub follow-up. Action reuse assessment: extend Zaq.Ingestion.sync_data_source_permissions/3, Zaq.Channels.DataSourceBridge permission contracts, DiskBridge/Storage ACL APIs, and Zaq.Permissions grant/revoke primitives; create one missing composable Action under Zaq.Agent.Tools.DataSource and explicitly register it for agent use.
title: Implement incremental data-source permission Action
